content.title: Generalization Mechanics in Deep Learning
content.TL;DR: Uncovers an implicit regularization in deep learning, and gives a new approach to obtain non-vacuous generalization bound
content.abstract:
Deep neural nets are well known for their ability to generalize, but understanding the mechanics of generalization remains an important open question. We analyze the probability-flow through a deep net, especially what happens to this flow during the training process.
Quantitatively, this study leads to a new approach for obtaining generalization bounds, using which we derive a non-vacuous bound for an over-parameterized deep network that learns relatively small dataset such as CIFAR-10. On the qualitative side, this reveals that
the process of learning imposes an implicit regularization, \viz orbit-regularization, as an essential ingredient for generalization.
